dose.amount: TSH, ALT/AST, GGT, ALP on the baseline draw

targets.expect: TSH between 0.5 and 2.5 mIU/L

evidence.title: Secondary causes of dyslipidaemia: exclude hypothyroidism before labelling

followUp.ask: What were TSH, ALT and GGT?

actions.title: Add a urine albumin/creatinine ratio (rule kidney_two_markers)
actions.why: Kidneys are graded on two numbers, filtration and leak. You have creatinine but no urine albumin, so half the picture is missing.
actions.reasoning: Fired rule kidney_two_markers. Ask for serum creatinine with eGFR on the same draw.

dose.amount: One spot morning urine sample

targets.expect: Below 30 mg/g, ideally below 10

followUp.ask: What were your urine ACR and eGFR?

actions.title: Measure vitamin D (rule vitamin_d_measure)
actions.why: Vitamin D has never been measured, and it is the cheapest deficiency there is to find and to fix.
actions.reasoning: Fired rule vitamin_d_measure. No supplement until the number is known; the ceiling is 10000 IU/day.

dose.amount: 25-OH vitamin D, one blood draw

targets.expect: 25-OH D between 30 and 50 ng/mL

followUp.ask: What was your 25-OH vitamin D?

questions.text: How many grams of carbohydrate do you eat on an average day now?
questions.why: It sets the size of the carbohydrate trial and tells us how strict your keto is.

questions.text: Which fats do you eat most: butter, cream, coconut or MCT oil, fatty meat, or olive oil, nuts and fish?
questions.why: Saturated fat load can add tens of mg/dL to LDL and changes what we swap first.
options: Butter, cream, coconut or MCT oil

questions.text: Does anyone in your family have very high cholesterol, a stroke or a heart attack at any age, or a known high Lp(a)?
questions.why: Family history of high Lp(a) or familial hypercholesterolaemia would end the LMHR framing and bring forward treatment.

patterns.stage: Full triad: LDL 215, HDL 92, TG 48, BMI 22.4, keto 2 years; workup not yet done
patterns.verdict: Matched. Measure ApoB, Lp(a) and CAC now, then run the 6-week carbohydrate trial. Zero CAC with Lp(a) below 50 means you may choose to stay low-carb with imaging every 2–3 years; any CAC or Lp(a) above 50 means treat ApoB like anyone else's, starting with carbohydrate.
